Hi Jacob and Elena,

Thanks for the intro, Jacob. Quick note from Redwood's side — we’re excited about the MediSync Labs opportunity and want to move the ACE registration + PDM/PSM introductions forward. To keep things efficient for the ACE intake, could we confirm the PDM/PSM contacts and run a short technical qualification call next week?

What we need for the intake:
- PDM and PSM point-of-contact (name + email) from AWS
- High-level usage profile (expected QPS, typical request size, peak sequences)
- Any compliance or data residency constraints (HIPAA / EU data flow, etc.)

Proposed next steps:
1) AWS confirms PDM/PSM and shares ACE registration link / form.
2) Technical qualification call (30–45m) to cover infra, SLOs, and integration surface.
3) Redwood fills ACE intake with the required technical answers and submits.

I've attached a short intake snapshot that covers Redwood's typical deployment options and a proposed agenda. If next Tue/Thu mornings PT work for the group, I can send a calendar invite.

Attachments: redwood-ace-intake.pdf (1 page)

Appreciate the help — cc'd Karthik and Marissa from our GTM team so they can join the intake and help with co-sell planning.

Thanks,

Hi all,

Thanks — Sophie and Brian, good to meet you. We’re keen to get ACE setup so we can co-sell with AWS. A few details from our side to help with the technical qualification:

- Primary workload: clinical document normalization — expect ~25–40 requests/sec during business hours, spiky up to ~120 req/sec during batch imports. Typical prompt size 400–1,200 tokens.
- Data residency: all patient data must remain in the US region; we will provide a signed BAA and are HIPAA aware.
- Auth: we plan to front requests through an internal gateway; tokens will be short-lived bearer tokens (OIDC).
- Non-functional asks: 95th percentile latency target under 1.2s for single-shot generation.

I’ve attached a simple infra diagram and a spreadsheet with anticipated QPS by environment. We can make procurement available for paperwork after PDM/PSM confirm the support model and next steps.

Attachments: medisync-infra-diagram.png (diagram), medisync-qps-estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet — sent separately to procurement)

Best,
Elena
VP Product | MediSync Labs
elena@medisynclabs.com

4) ACE registration questions & procurement timeline (10m)
